paras.en: Summarize the role of parents, educators, government administration and society at large in eradication of drug abuse in the light of the text of the lesson ‘Drug Abuse in Youth of Pakistan’.

paras.en: Create and deliver class presentations on the impact of drug abuse on families and society at large and also suggest some workable solutions for this problem. While delivering the presentation the following points should be kept in mind:

paras.en: Using your knowledge of literal and figurative meaning, grammatical gender and syntax, translate the following dialogue from English into Urdu.
paras.ur: لغوی اور مجازی معنی، گرامر کی جنس اور نحو کے اپنے علم کو استعمال کرتے ہوئے درج ذیل مکالمے کا انگریزی سے اردو میں ترجمہ کریں۔

paras.en: Rubi: “Going well, Kamal. What’ve you been up to lately?”
paras.ur: روبی: “ٹھیک چل رہے ہیں، کمال۔ آج کل آپ کیا کر رہے ہیں؟”
paras.ps: روبي: “ښه روان دي، کمال. دا ورځې تاسو څه کوئ؟”

paras.en: Kamal: “Oh, not much. Work’s been busy. Oh, by the way, did you get a hold of Waqar about that real estate deal we were talking about?”

paras.en: Rubi: “I haven’t been able to reach him yet. But the decision is really not up to him anyway. Let me know if you still want it. If you don’t, now is the time to back out. If you’re still interested, I’ll tell the real estate agent to go ahead and buy that office building. He’ll follow through with it right away. He should have all the paperwork filled out by Friday.”
